title: Public application-mail edge function lacks caller authentication
control: no auth/session check before request.json and Resend call
sink: fetch to api.resend.com with env API key
impact: unauthenticated mail sending / abuse of mail quota

evidence: the function accepts any request with CORS `*`, reads arbitrary JSON, chooses recipients from body.to when present, and never validates an Authorization token or Supabase session before sending mail

impact: spam, unauthorized recipient targeting, and API-key-backed outbound mail abuse
